subject: science
name: Science
course: Earth & Space Science: Geological Systems & Weather
title: Grade 6 Science: Earth & Space Science: Geological Systems & Weather
overview: Grade 6 Science explores the interconnected systems of the physical, life, and Earth/space sciences using inquiry-based labs, computational modeling, and engineering design aligned with NGSS.
competencies: Formulate testable hypotheses, design empirical experiments, and interpret complex data graphs.
Construct and revise scientific models explaining matter, energy, and biological systems.
Apply mathematical relationships and physical laws to predict natural phenomena.
Evaluate technological solutions to ecological and societal challenges.

modules.title: Earth's Systems: Plate Tectonics & Rock Cycling
modules.description: Modeling Earth's interior layers, mantle convection, continental drift, plate boundaries, and the cycling of rock materials.

topics.title: Plate Tectonics and Crustal Deformations
topics.description: Analyzing convergent, divergent, and transform plate boundaries and seafloor spreading.

topics.title: The Rock Cycle and Geoscience Processes
topics.description: Tracing the transformations between igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks driven by heat and pressure.

modules.title: Weather, Atmosphere & Ocean Currents
modules.description: Investigating solar atmospheric heating, atmospheric pressure, global wind belts, and ocean currents shaping regional climates.

topics.title: Air Masses, Fronts and Weather Prediction
topics.description: Modeling how air masses of different temperatures and moisture collide to produce storms.

topics.title: Ocean Circulation and Global Climate Systems
topics.description: Analyzing how ocean currents redistribute thermal energy globally and influence regional weather patterns.

modules.title: Space Systems: Solar System Astronomy
modules.description: Modeling solar system gravity, planetary orbits, lunar phases, solar and lunar eclipses, and the scale of the universe.

topics.title: Lunar Phases, Eclipses and Seasonal Tilt
topics.description: Demonstrating how Earth's 23.5-degree axial tilt creates seasons and how orbits cause eclipses.

topics.title: Gravity and Solar System Scale Models
topics.description: Constructing computational scale models of the planets and analyzing gravitational orbital mechanics.
